method.database: One untimed smoke, then four serial pairs: fresh typed reader (cold-reader, OS cache uncontrolled) followed by same-reader repeat (warm-reader). Setup and correctness excluded. No p95/p99 claims.
method.frontend: Four fresh mounted product harnesses; first Inspector mount and recent Overview-to-Inspector return. Fixed 500-row mock API, content and current membership readiness separate; no browser paint claim.
method.budgets: Uncalibrated: timings are observations, never a latency pass. Correctness is mandatory. No invented numerical target.

release_requirements.reason: Owned native fixture launch and independent rendered authority adapter are not yet integrated. Mounted timings do not prove scroll/layout restoration, trace drawing, native latency or zero H5 reads.
Transactional doubles prove correctness only; no owned native MySQL timing fixture in this core.
Small H5 parsing/import identity tests are correctness only, not end-to-end native ingestion throughput.

gaps.reason: Current eligible-field oracle excludes some deep paths, long arrays/strings and ticks. Independent all-raw-field inventory required; all fields must remain accessible regardless acceleration tier.
Tier promotion/demotion with exact membership/order/types/units and slow correct fallback not implemented.
Explicit unavailable/extraction-incomplete semantics for arbitrary raw fields not implemented; never infer empty success.
Design only: compare static, instrumented-fixed, adaptive, manually tuned; count telemetry/build/refresh/contention cost.
Design only: workload shift, rare export, updates, deduplication, hysteresis, cooldown, manual pins.
Generalized metadata JSON importer not implemented.
Metadata-only export vNext and Attach Traces not implemented. Current SQLite export has source pointers, not portable raw data.
Core is 12 sealed metadata records and 500 mocked frontend rows, not representative large acquisition scale; separate stress plan applies.
